entities.name: Oldřich Vašíček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Oldřich Alfons Vašíček is a Czech mathematician and quantitative analyst, 

best known for his pioneering work on interest rate and credit modelling; with the eponymous Vasicek model and KMV model.
